description: Add a new hire and return its H-NNNN id: a name, a role and the day they start. The role is a grouping key, lower-cased and hyphenated. Add tasks with onboarding_task_add, or apply a role template with onboarding_template_apply.

name.description: The hire's name, e.g. Ada Lovelace

role.description: The role, e.g. engineer or sales. Lower-cased and hyphenated

start_date.description: The day they start, YYYY-MM-DD. Task due dates are counted from here

name: onboarding_hire_add
title: Add a hire
